title: Playbooks — Digital / Agile / DevOps
lead: Curated, ready-to-use guidance documents that accelerate the implementation of Digital, Agile and DevOps practices in client organisations.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Playbooks are structured reference documents that translate methodology into practical guidance. Each playbook covers a specific practice area — such as DevOps, Agile delivery or Digital transformation — and provides principles, patterns, tools and worked examples that teams can apply immediately.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Playbooks accelerate operating model implementation by giving teams a proven starting point rather than designing from scratch. In ITOM engagements, playbooks are adapted to the client's context and used as foundational artefacts for the new ways of working.

items.desc: End-to-end guidance on implementing DevOps — from culture and organisation to CI/CD and platform.
Practical patterns for agile delivery at team and programme level.
Structured approach to digital change — strategy, delivery and governance.
